sn17.11:1.3: idhāhaṃ bhikkhave, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi.
sn17.11:1.4: “na cāyamāyasmā suvaṇṇapātiyāpi rūpiyacuṇṇaparipūrāya hetu sampajānamusā bhāseyyā”ti.
sn17.11:1.5: tamenaṃ passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtaṃ pariyādinnacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ.
sn17.11:1.7: [uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma …pe…] evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave, sikkhitabbanti.
